notes.title: Weapon Update has arrived!
notes.content:
Three new weapons has been added to the game:

[b]Cryosaber[/b] - A short blade, encased in a layer of smooth, clear ice. With a great slash, the blade channels its wielder psychic power.

[b]Wingrazor[/b] - A weapon of beautiful terror, depicting an outlandish mythical creature. It can be hurled at foes, and called back, soaring effortlessly through the air.

[b]Gunaxe[/b] - A vicious scythe, married elegantly with a functioning gun barrel. Like most guns, it can be loaded and fired.

Getting your hands on these new weapons will require defeating their owners in a deadly duel.

After getting all three weapons a new Challenge awaits for the most hardcore of players.

Unfortunately, the Good Ending still seems to be out of reach...
